title: Free-floating Subdivisions: Corporate Bodies
scope: Topical and form subdivisions usable on a free-floating basis, within the limits of the usage notes, under names of individual corporate bodies established in the name authority file (businesses, institutions, associations, religious organizations, political parties, government agencies, exhibitions, fairs, etc.); not under conferences/meetings, jurisdictions, or types of organizations
general_notes: LC practice: As stated in H 1075, LC catalogers will no longer use form subdivisions. Instead assign an appropriate term or terms from Library of Congress Genre/Form Terms (LCGFT), e.g. *Textbooks*.

Additional or varying subdivisions may be used under names of individual corporate bodies that fall within categories covered by specific pattern headings: H 1151 for individual educational institutions; H 1155 for individual legislative bodies; H 1159 for individual military services; H 1186 for individual religious and monastic orders; H 1187 for individual Christian denominations.
Some subdivisions on this list represent classes of person, for example, *--Employees* and *--Officials and employees*. See H 1100 for further subdivisions used under classes of persons.

This list has no May Subd Geog column; geographic subdivision is stated in the notes ("May subd geog." / "Not subd geog."). may_subd_geog is true only where the note authorizes it; all other entries are not subdivided geographically.
